input.prompt: Documentary-style photograph of an elderly fisherman mending a fishing net on a weathered wooden pier at early morning. He sits on an upturned wooden crate, weathered hands working a tangle of brown cotton net across his knees, a needle threaded with twine between his fingers. Deep wrinkles, grey stubble, a faded blue wool cap, and a worn oilskin jacket. Coils of net and a few cork floats lie around his feet on the planks. Behind him, moored fishing boats bob in calm harbour water, and soft mist hangs over the sea under a pale sky. Natural available light, soft directional morning sun, candid unposed moment, shallow depth of field, 35mm lens look, true-to-life colour with muted tones, photojournalistic framing with the subject slightly off-centre.
